// The path of a rim point on a circle of radius RollingRadius rolling outside
// a fixed circle of radius FixedRadius. Closes after a whole number of laps
// when the radius ratio is rational; the canonical parameter covers one lap
// around the fixed circle (https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Epicycloid).
type Epicycloid2D
    implements ICurve2D
{
    FixedRadius: Number;
    RollingRadius: Number;
}
